sections.Profile:
The "Wild West" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1951, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, marking his final design for the company.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Wood Rail, Native Americans, Horses, Original Theme, Guns, Approachable, Cowboys
